11777 IS-02 and electrical connecand its

The screening collar surrounding the pins is made of metal continuation inside the plug ensures electrical screening. 14

IS : 11773 ( Part 1 ) - 1986 The rib inside the screening collar together with the corresponding groove of the socket connector prevents incorrect insertion of the plug. A spring inside the socket connector provides for contact between the collar and the screening of the socket connector. A-2. FIXED THREE-SOCKET CONNECTOR EQUIPMENT, 11777 IS-02 FOR SOUND

A-2.1 This connector mates with the pin connector and serves to connect The electrical connections are given in a microphone to the equipment. Table 1. A-2.2 Supporting llangc and shell may be of metal or plastic as required. The screening collar of the pin connector extcnclj iuto the socket connector so that in most casts adequate screening is ensured, even when the shell is made of plastic. The shell has a spring co:ltact with termination for a screen or earth lead, ensuring proper contact with the screening collar of the pin connector, A-2.3 The metal version has an electrical connection between the spring contact and the shell. The groove in the insulator of the socket connector together with the rib in the screenin g collar of the pin connector prevents incorrect insertion of the plug. A-2.4 The blind holes in the insulator allow insertion connector ( 11777 IS-03 ) into the socket conllector. of a five-pole pin

If the blind holes are undesirable in view of the possibility of incorrect insertion, agreement between customer and manufacturer should be reached to omit these. A-3. FREE TAPE FIVE-PIN CONNECTOR RECORDER, 11777 15-03 FOR RECORD PLAYER AND

A-3.1 This connector mates with the five-socket connector 11777 IS-04 and serves to connect a record player or a tape recorder to a radio receiver or to sound equipment.
